# Preference: Learning Style

## Statement

Alex learns best by doing — building projects, writing code, and experimenting with real tools.

## Context

Reading documentation is useful but learning solidifies when writing actual code.
Alex prefers building small side projects to learn new technologies rather than following tutorials passively.
Spaced repetition is used to retain facts and concepts over time.
New skills are usually learned by picking a real problem and solving it with the new tool.
